bends.reason: B1 (seq 1): long-edge flange on the B1 side (right junction in SIDE, top edge in TOP, far edge in ISO). Raw SIDE view shows a U-channel cross-section with this flange standing ~90 deg to the web, with a visible bend radius and the same height as the CAD. Raw TOP shows the flange edge-on as a double line along the full length, and the part width equals the CAD width, so no flange lies flat in the web plane. Raw ISO shows the far-flange overlap band from end to end. The overlay (registration confidence OK) puts the scan on the CAD B1 line. It folds to the same side of the web as B2, matching the CAD (not reversed). There are no bend_<seq>.png sections for this case (manifest group STATE_CHECK, sections=false), so it was judged from the global raw views, with the overlay as a cross-check only.

B2 (seq 2): opposite long-edge flange (left junction in SIDE, bottom edge in TOP, near edge in ISO). Raw SIDE shows it standing ~90 deg to the web with a bend radius, mirroring B1 and at the CAD height. Raw TOP shows it edge-on along the full length, with the part width equal to the CAD. Raw ISO and FRONT show its outer face as a full-length band below the near edge, with the same corner relief at the B3 end as the CAD. The overlay puts the scan on the CAD B2 line. It folds to the same side as B1, matching the CAD (not reversed). Judged from the global raw views; there are no section images (STATE_CHECK).

B3 (seq 3): short-end tab. Raw FRONT shows a vertical L at the end with a visible bend radius, the tab standing ~90 deg to the web (a slight 2-3 deg lean, within springback). Raw TOP shows the tab edge-on as a dark strip at the end, and the web does not continue past the bend line (an unformed tab would lengthen the part by the tab height). Raw ISO shows the tab standing past the far edge, and raw SIDE shows it face-on as a full-width rectangle. REVERSE-DIRECTION bend: B3 folds to the side of the web opposite the B1/B2 flanges, in both the recipe CAD and the scan, so the scan follows the recipe direction. The overlay puts the scan on the CAD B3 line. Judged from the global raw views; there are no section images (STATE_CHECK).
